shortcut_name: Connected N-minus-one graph is a tree

evidence.quote: DFS to find minimal subtree connecting all targets

affordance_in_statement: It is guaranteed that if you were to purchase all E available difference vectors, their linear span would contain the difference b_x - b_y for any 1 <= x, y <= N. ... E = N - 1.
removal_suggestion: Re-present the promise algebraically, for example by stating only that the full vector set has rank N-1 and omitting the explicit all-pairs difference/connectivity interpretation; this hides the tree reduction while preserving the same mathematical task.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes the input graph as a tree and directly computes the weighted minimal subtree containing all targets.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: E = N - 1 together with the guarantee that all-pairs differences lie in the full span.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Roots and processes the structure explicitly as a tree, then selects the edges needed to connect the target vertices.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: E = N - 1 together with the full-span guarantee.

common_affordance: The full difference-vector graph is connected and has exactly N-1 edges, so it is a weighted tree; satisfying the target span is therefore exactly connecting all target vertices in that tree.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Uses generic Kruskal/union-find logic rather than exploiting that the available edges already form a tree, so it does not correctly account for the unique Steiner paths and required non-target connector vertices.
Also applies a generic minimum-spanning/union-find strategy instead of computing the unique target-connecting subtree forced by the tree structure.

recommended_edit: Replace the explicit sentence saying that the full set spans every b_x-b_y with an indirect rank-based promise, such as saying that the full vector set has rank N-1, and avoid describing the vectors as an undirected connectivity structure. This is the only shared shortcut, although the tree reduction remains mathematically intrinsic.
regression_risk: The edit may not defeat robust solvers: the immutable E=N-1 condition plus the rank promise still mathematically implies a connected tree.
